en.purpose: To derive the clinical TNM sub-category string and stage group for ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal carcinoma based on recorded clinical TNM categories.
en.use:
Use to stage ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal carcinoma by deriving the clinical TNM stage group from recorded clinical Tumour (T), Node (N), and Metastasis (M) categories according to the UICC TNM 8th edition classification.

Inputs
- Clinical T category (primary tumour extent): TX, T0, T1, T1a, T1b, T1c1, T1c2, T1c3, T2, T2a, T2b, T3a, T3b, T3c
- Clinical N category (regional lymph node involvement): NX, N0, N1, N1a, N1b
- Clinical M category (distant metastasis): M0, M1, M1a, M1b

Outputs
- TNM sub-category string (for example, T1aN0M0)
- Derived TNM stage group (Stage I–IV)
en.misuse: Not to be used for pathological TNM (pTNM) staging. Not to be used for staging of other gynaecological malignancies.

other_details.en: A clinical staging guideline used to assign TNM stage group for ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal carcinoma based on recorded clinical tumour extent, lymph node involvement, and presence of distant metastasis.
